description: 做一张通用双输入张量计算引擎的微架构示意。一个独立DMA从片外Memory读取A和B两路数据，分别送到Unpacker A和Unpacker B，各自写入Source Registers A和Source Registers B；FPU接收两组源值，内部有常规Arithmetic Unit和Special Function Unit两条可选择的执行路径，算术与特殊函数不要求互相串联。计算结果写入Result Registers，经Packer送回同一个DMA，再写回同一片外Memory；独立Control Unit负责解包、计算和打包的发起与协调。除片外Memory外，这些资源都属于该计算引擎，FPU内部包含关系要准确。按概念示意补齐必要的普通协调细节即可，不指定容量、精度、带宽或周期数。
style_prompt:
STYLE CONTRACT CPS5-paper-2a026e31fb
Keep this same visual system across every figure in the document.
Palette: background #FFFFFF; ink #263238; primary #EDF2F5; secondary #E8EEE8; muted #F7F8F9.
A compact publication figure on pure white, like an architecture-paper hardware diagram. No shadows, glow, depth, texture or gradients.
Geometry follows hardware role: shallow queue/register bars, tight compute rectangles, interfaces with aligned ports, taller banked memories only when supported by their specification. Do not use uniform square cards.
Use subdued blue-gray for compute and pale sage for storage; control and interfaces stay white. Color is sparse and follows role; at most three fill roles plus neutral gray.
One neutral sans-serif family, normal/medium-weight module names and regular signal labels. Thin dark data lines, slightly thinner gray dashed control lines, small arrowheads. Group titles are subordinate and boundaries do not create large empty panels.
For a 1600px-wide publication figure, start with main labels F=20–24px and signal labels 18–20px. Use normal/medium weight, not heavy bold billboard text. Widen or wrap exact names into two lines; never make a short name occupy a large padded card.
A small 3% white perimeter and compact signal corridors. Containers have very thin neutral outlines with little padding, never large empty blue frames. Solid fills only; no page texture. Use Noto Sans CJK / Microsoft YaHei-like sans-serif for Chinese.
Use narrow engineering strokes and small arrowheads; primary paths may be slightly stronger but never thick flowchart arrows. Labels sit in open gaps. A crossing without a dot is not a connection.
Use a concise legend only for conventions actually used. No ornamental page furniture.

spec.layout: Left-to-right main data path: n_mem at far left, then n_dma, then two parallel unpack lanes n_unpackA (upper) and n_unpackB (lower) feeding n_srcA and n_srcB; n_srcA/n_srcB fan into g_fpu in the center, where n_alu and n_sfu sit as two parallel selectable paths; both converge on n_result, then n_packer, then back to n_dma and n_mem. g_engine encloses everything except n_mem. n_ctrl sits in a control corridor along the bottom of g_engine, with dashed control edges fanning up to n_dma, n_unpackA, n_unpackB, n_alu, n_sfu, n_packer; feedback edges from n_result and n_dma return along the bottom corridor. Reading order: memory -> DMA -> unpack -> source registers -> FPU -> result -> packer -> DMA -> memory, with control corridor read last.
annotations: Arithmetic Unit and Special Function Unit are alternative selectable paths; they are not chained in series.
All resources except Off-Chip Memory belong to the Tensor Compute Engine.
assumptions: 容量、精度、带宽、周期数均未指定，图中不标注任何具体数值。
Control Unit 到各模块的发起/协调连线为通用示意，用户仅说明其负责解包、计算、打包的发起与协调。
Result Registers 与 DMA 的完成回报为补齐的普通协调细节，可按实际设计修改。
questions: 是否需要把 Control Unit 的发起/协调关系细化为具体信号或握手时序？
是否需要为 FPU 两条执行路径补充选择条件或优先级？
checks: 确认 FPU 内部仅包含 Arithmetic Unit 与 Special Function Unit 两个执行单元，且二者为并列可选而非串联。
确认 DMA 为单一独立模块，同时承担读入 A/B 与写回结果。
确认除 Off-Chip Memory 外所有模块都画在 Tensor Compute Engine 容器内。
